`202-209`: ** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Unverified finding** Verification ran but could not confirm this finding. It is shown for review, not as a verified issue. **Do not report malformed usage as zero tokens.** If `model_extra['usage'].model_dump()` contains an invalid token count, parsing fails and this handler emits an `LLM_END` event with the zero-valued default. Downstream usage statistics cannot distinguish that event from one with no reported usage. Limit the fallback to absent streaming fields. Handle a present but invalid usage value separately. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Agent-Toolkit/8f385d66cc569427d78c524956b2c321cb130881/packages/nvidia_nat_crewai/src/nat/plugins/crewai/crewai_callback_handler.py)) Based on learnings, a malformed optional usage field must not be treated as absent. _Source: Learnings_
